AutoGPT — Your team of AI Experts

Bring in specialists for content, sales, research, and recurring work.
Brief them in plain English. Let Otto coordinate.

Sign up for a trial · Watch the demo · Meet the Experts · Pricing · Self-host · Contribute

## One conversation. The right expertise. Tell Otto what's on your plate. It brings in the right Experts, hands over the work, and keeps you up to date. Talk to a specialist directly when you want to get into the details. Each Expert has a role you can shape with your instructions, context, skills, and connected apps. Start with a ready-made specialist or create your own. | Meet your team | Put them to work | | --- | --- | | **Otto · Head of AI** | Coordinate a job across specialists and bring their work back to you. | | **Maria · SEO Content Manager** | Turn a target keyword into a content brief and article draft. | | **Max · Account Executive** | Research prospects, draft outreach, and prepare the next conversation. | | **Frankie · Executive Assistant** | Prepare meeting context, email drafts, and a digest for the day. | [Explore the Experts →](https://agpt.co/experts/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=team_experts) ## See the team at work One launch brief to Otto. Maria prepares the article, Max researches prospects, and Frankie prepares the launch review. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/83cddd83-00f8-46e7-be9e-e0a7237c7eea **[Watch the full 45-second demo →](https://agpt.co/videos/otto-team-demo-v1-1080.mp4)** · [Sign up for a trial](https://platform.agpt.co/signup?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=demo_get_started) A 15-second highlight of a real run, edited and sped up. In this example, the team prepares the work for review without sending or publishing it. ## From a first brief to a routine 1. **Choose your Expert.** Tell Otto what you need, pick a specialist, or create one for your own way of working. 2. **Brief them on the job.** Share the context, connect the apps they need, and agree on the first outcome. 3. **Review and refine.** Check the work and adjust the instructions. Activate routines for jobs that keep coming back. You choose which accounts each Expert can access, set spending controls, and follow progress in their activity. [See how it works →](https://agpt.co/how-it-works/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=how_it_works) ## Get started ### AutoGPT Platform Use the hosted Platform to get your team running without managing the infrastructure or supplying model API keys. **[Sign up for a trial →](https://platform.agpt.co/signup?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=platform_get_started)** The hosted Platform is a paid service. See [current plans, trial terms, and usage pricing](https://agpt.co/pricing/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=platform_pricing). ### Self-host AutoGPT Run AutoGPT on your own infrastructure. You provide model credentials, configure the deployment, and manage its updates and operation. The quickest way to self-host is the single-container image on Docker Hub, [`significantgravitas/autogpt`](https://hub.docker.com/r/significantgravitas/autogpt): ```bash docker run -d \ --name autogpt \ --restart unless-stopped \ --shm-size 2g \ --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \ --log-driver json-file \ --log-opt max-size=50m \ --log-opt max-file=5 \ -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \ -e AUTOGPT_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 \ -v autogpt-data:/data \ significantgravitas/autogpt:latest ``` Give the first boot a few minutes, then open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000), create your account, and make it the administrator: ```bash docker exec autogpt autogpt-admin promote you@example.com ``` Requirements, closing signup, ports, model providers, backups, and upgrades are covered in the guide: [Read the single-container guide →](https://agpt.co/docs/platform/self-hosting/single-container) On Linux, macOS, and Windows, the [installer](https://agpt.co/docs/platform/self-hosting/installer#install) sets up the same image with one command. To run each service in its own container with Docker Compose, or to develop from source, use the [manual self-hosting guide](https://agpt.co/docs/platform/self-hosting/getting-started#manual-setup). | | Hosted Platform | Self-hosted | | --- | --- | --- | | Setup and operations | Managed by AutoGPT | Managed by you | | Model access | Built in | Bring your own model credentials or a local model | | Cost | Paid plan and usage | Your infrastructure and model usage | | Data and infrastructure | Hosted by AutoGPT | Runs on your infrastructure | See the [license](#license) for the repository's usage terms. ## Workflows when you need more control Experts can use skills and workflows to do their jobs. Get started

AutoGPT Platform

Use the hosted Platform to get your team running without managing the infrastructure or supplying model API keys.

Sign up for a trial →

The hosted Platform is a paid service. See current plans, trial terms, and usage pricing.

Self-host AutoGPT

Run AutoGPT on your own infrastructure. You provide model credentials, configure the deployment, and manage its updates and operation.

The quickest way to self-host is the single-container image on Docker Hub, significantgravitas/autogpt:

docker run -d \
  --name autogpt \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  --shm-size 2g \
  --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \
  --log-driver json-file \
  --log-opt max-size=50m \
  --log-opt max-file=5 \
  -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -e AUTOGPT_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 \
  -v autogpt-data:/data \
  significantgravitas/autogpt:latest

Give the first boot a few minutes, then open http://localhost:3000, create your account, and make it the administrator:

docker exec autogpt autogpt-admin promote you@example.com

Requirements, closing signup, ports, model providers, backups, and upgrades are covered in the guide:

Read the single-container guide →

On Linux, macOS, and Windows, the installer sets up the same image with one command.

To run each service in its own container with Docker Compose, or to develop from source, use the manual self-hosting guide.

releases.name: 🚀 AutoGPT Platform v0.10.0
releases.body:
## 🔥 What's New?

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- **#15970** - Self-hosted Docker Compose generates its own service passwords per install and won't start without them: run `make init-env` (or the installer) before `docker compose up`. PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, FalkorDB and ClamAV now listen on `127.0.0.1` only. Existing installs: see [Upgrading: service passwords are generated per install](https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT/blob/master/docs/platform/getting-started.md#upgrading-service-passwords-are-generated-per-install) (by @ntindle)
- **#12206** - External API v1 is deprecated in favour of the new v2, and keeps working until 2027-01-31 (by @Pwuts)

### New Features

- **#15990** - Record when each API key was last used (by @ntindle)
- **#15862** - Tell chat-platform bots where each message came from (by @Bentlybro)
- **#16023** - Role and text design tokens at today's values (DS1) (by @Abhi1992002)
- **#16035** - Send product mail only to subscribers, trialists and accounts that lapsed in the last 7 days (by @Torantulino)
- **#16037** - Molecules read only role tokens, same look (DS2b) (by @Abhi1992002)

releases.name: Preview seed fixture (rolling)
releases.body: Rolling, fully SYNTHETIC preview-database seed fixture baked from dev@42659ea6e0b9 (migration head: 20261026120000_normalize_org_invitation_email). Preview environments restore fixture.dump.gz (custom-format, gzipped, platform schema only, including _prisma_migrations) BEFORE running a PR's own migrations, so schema changes run against populated tables. RESTORE: apply restore-preamble.sql to the target database first (it creates the platform schema and installs the vector + pg_trgm extensions into it, which pg_dump --schema=platform omits), then run 'gunzip -c fixture.dump.gz | pg_restore -d <db> --no-owner' WITHOUT --exit-on-error (the dump's own CREATE SCHEMA collides benignly with the preamble's). SECURITY INVARIANT: this bake holds no cloud credentials and has no read path to any real database — it runs entirely against a throwaway Postgres container and contains only Faker-generated synthetic rows plus the already-public marketplace agent exports checked into autogpt_platform/backend/agents/. This asset is regenerated on every eligible dev push and weekly; treat it as disposable.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An experimental open-source framework for building autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: AutoGPT is an advanced, open-source framework designed to create and manage autonomous AI agents driven by Large Language Models. Unlike standard conversational interfaces, it enables models to break down high-level objectives into actionable tasks, reasoning through them sequentially. The framework provides agents with internet access, file system operations, and long-term memory management via vector databases. It executes code and interacts with external APIs autonomously to achieve complex, open-ended goals with minimal human intervention. Currently highly experimental, it serves as a foundational platform for researching and developing the next generation of autonomous AI systems.
keyFeatures: Autonomous task execution: Breaks down complex objectives into sequential steps and executes them without continuous human prompting.
Internet browsing capabilities: Searches the web and reads pages dynamically to gather up-to-date information for decision making.
Long-term memory integration: Utilizes vector databases to store and retrieve contextual information across extended reasoning sessions.
File system access: Reads, writes, and modifies local files to generate reports, code, or data structures autonomously.
Extensible architecture: Supports a wide array of plugins and external API integrations to expand the agent's core capabilities.

useCases.description: Instruct the system to scaffold a complete web application by writing files, installing dependencies, and debugging errors iteratively.

useCases.title: Complex Data Aggregation
useCases.description: Command the agent to navigate multiple data sources, extract relevant statistics, and synthesize the findings into a cohesive summary.

useCases.title: AI Agent Research
useCases.description: Experiment with multi-step reasoning and autonomous planning capabilities using a customizable, open-source framework.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: AI researchers, advanced developers, and experimenters interested in the bleeding edge of autonomous agent capabilities. It requires a strong technical background and an understanding that the system is highly experimental and prone to unpredictable behavior.
